question: Why did browser automation testing grow so quickly with JavaScript?
Which popular test automation tools are written in JavaScript?
answer:
Playwright, Cypress, WebdriverIO, Puppeteer, Nightwatch, TestCafe, Vitest, Jest and Supertest are all JavaScript projects. They cover browser work, API work and unit work with the same syntax.

code:
const tools = [
  ['playwright', 'browser, multi engine'],
  ['cypress', 'browser, single engine'],
  ['webdriverio', 'browser, webdriver protocol'],
  ['supertest', 'api testing'],
  ['vitest', 'unit testing'],
];
tools.forEach(([name, job]) => console.log(name.padEnd(12), job));

real example:
A job description asking for three years of Cypress and Playwright is really asking for JavaScript plus browser knowledge, so the language is the transferable half.
